WITH scope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    u.acctscope,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(cnt) as total_count,
    AVG(cnt) as avg_count
  FROM scope_counts
)
SELECT 
  sc.acctscope,
  sc.cnt as count,
  CAST(sc.cnt AS REAL) / t.total_count as fraction,
  CAST(sc.cnt AS REAL) / t.avg_count as div_by_avg
FROM scope_counts sc
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY sc.acctscope
